newsitem.title: UK: LME copper creeps higher in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper creeps higher in late trading.

text.p: LME copper edged higher in late inter-office trading on Monday evening, extending a late bounce.
Three months copper was indicated as high as $2,280/84 per tonne, up from a $2,270 afternoon kerb close.
But by 1900 GMT, it has come back to $2,273/76.

Fresh fund and commission house buying boosted copper after New York opened, but the market still needs to confront resistance at $2,292, the high of January 16, before it can break out of its range, analysts said.
The other metals were little changed.
